notes: Summary: Arcturus runs a multi-tenant query+rerank pipeline for logistics search and tracking. Heavy tail traffic: sustained steady-state chat/rerank at ~600 QPS, median token/sec ~45, average response length 120 tokens; nightly batch reindexing creates short bursts with effective token/sec > 10k for 10-15 minutes. Wants dedicated GPU pools with predictable throughput and hard latency SLOs (p95 <= 150ms, p99 <= 300ms) under steady-state; willing to accept slightly higher p99 during known batch windows if cost tradeoffs recommended. Primary asks: 1) recommended reserved GPU count for steady-state vs burst (we should size baseline + 3x burst capacity or provide burst autoscaling with cold-start guarantees), 2) latency SLO tiers and credits model, 3) routing/fallback: prefer in-region Dedicated -> Dedicated spare capacity -> Private fallback, 4) network & residency: must keep EU subset for EU customers (data residency), 5) security: require SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs retained 1 year, and SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence. POC ask: 2-week Dedicated trial with synthetic replay of 48 hours of traffic (we need to provide kernel/quantization profile and expected token costs). Notes from SE: prefix cache hit-rate ~32% for common queries; batching opportunities exist for rerank (can increase throughput by 1.8x with RBC batching). Pricing sensitivity: CFO pushing for unit cost under $0.002/token for steady-state. Quote preference: include a dedicated reserved + burst cushion + fallback pricing matrix. Quoted blockers: procurement needs a clean SLA clause for outages related to kernel incompatibilities; legal needs clause for on-prem fallback behavior. Actions: schedule 2-hr sizing workshop (target week of 2026-03-22), prepare synthetic replay template, run rough GPU-count calc and capacity options (A100x40 vs H100x16 comparisons), draft term sheet with latency tiers and credits.\nShorthand entries: - "baseline_qps=600" - "peak_qps~2500 (10-15m bursts)" - "median_tokens_per_res=120" - "prefix_cache~32%" - "desired_p95<=150ms; p99<=300ms (steady)" - "preferred_deploy=dedicated+vpc; private for eu-only data"
